title: Hearth of Thorns
shortDescription: Living briar holds the glass and the light.
longDescription:
The Hearth of Thorns is half cloister and half greenhouse. Briar has been trained into trellises that remember every cut. Green light pools on the stone. Shears hang where a first-year can reach them and a second-year has learned not to rush.
Mentor Briar waits among the living walls as if the plants had asked her to stay.

fixtures.name: Mentor Briar
fixtures.lookDescription: A scarred hedgehog in a green cloak caught with thorns, shears at the belt. Try talk briar.
fixtures.examineDescription: Briar's quills are patched with old scratches. The cloak is mended with vine-thread. She speaks as if the plants were listening, and they usually are.
fixtures.dialogue: "Thorns teach patience that can still cut. Look this hearth. Find Flint in the South Orchard. Come back."

welcome.text: "I am Briar. Thorns grow where they are trained. Look this hearth. Walk to the South Orchard. Attack the dummy once. Return and talk to me."

craft.text: "A vine that is never cut becomes a snare. A vine that is only cut becomes a stick. You will learn the difference. First you look. Then you practice on Flint's dummy. Then you come back."

go.text: "Look the trellis. Then find the orchard. I will be here."

fixtures.name: Briar Trellis
fixtures.examineDescription: The living wood has been trained into a door that is also a warning. New growth is tied, not broken. A slate says: 'Ask before you cut.'
